/--
Substitute `old(var)` in expression `e` with `s`.
-/
def substOld (var : Expression.Ident) (s e : Expression.Expr) :
  Expression.Expr :=
  match e with
  | .const _ _ | .fvar _ _ _ | .bvar _ _ | .op _ _ _ => e
  | .abs m ty e' => .abs m ty (substOld var s e')
  | .quant m qk ty tr' e' => .quant m qk ty (substOld var s tr') (substOld var s e')
  | .app m e1 e2 =>
    match e1, e2 with
    | .op _ (CoreIdent.unres "old") _, .fvar _ x _ =>
      -- NOTE: We rely on the typeChecker to normalize `e` ensure that `old` is
      -- only used with an `fvar`.
      if x == var
        -- substitute, if should be substituted
        then s
        else e
    | _, _ => .app m (substOld var s e1) (substOld var s e2)
  | .ite m c t f => .ite m (substOld var s c)
                      (substOld var s t) (substOld var s f)
  | .eq m e1 e2 => .eq m (substOld var s e1) (substOld var s e2)

/--

theorem CoreIdent.isGlob_isGlobOrLocl :
  PredImplies (CoreIdent.isGlob ·) (CoreIdent.isGlobOrLocl ·) := by

  exact Or.symm (Or.inr H)

theorem CoreIdent.isLocl_isGlobOrLocl :
  PredImplies (CoreIdent.isLocl ·) (CoreIdent.isGlobOrLocl ·) := by

  exact Or.symm (Or.inl Hin)

theorem CoreIdent.Disjoint_isTemp_isGlobOrLocl :
  PredDisjoint (CoreIdent.isTemp ·) (CoreIdent.isGlobOrLocl ·) := by
  intros x H1 H2
  simp [CoreIdent.isTemp] at H1
  simp [CoreIdent.isGlobOrLocl] at H2
  split at H1 <;> simp_all
  cases H2 <;> simp [CoreIdent.isGlob, CoreIdent.isLocl] at *

  intros x H1 H2

  simp [CoreIdent.isGlob] at H2
  split at H1 <;> simp_all
